title: 🛫 New activities in MSFS Marketplace|Weekly Update|Master Your Flight Skills!|Week 19✈️
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Explore the newest training additions to the Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace week!  This week multiple new packages including a new package type from VA Systems. This new type of package include airport schedules for both specific airports as specific airliners. Watch now to see how you can elevate your flight simulation experience! 🌟

📹 Other marketplace additions
